IDComponentType.description:
- UNKNOWN: UNKNOWN represents an unknown or uninitialized component type
 - MULTIPOOLER: MULTIPOOLER represents a multipooler component
 - MULTIGATEWAY: MULTIGATEWAY represents a multigateway component
 - MULTIORCH: MULTIORCH represents a multiorch component
IDComponentType.title: ComponentType represents the type of Multigres component

clustermetadataAsyncReplicationFallbackM.description:
- ASYNC_REPLICATION_FALLBACK_MODE_UNKNOWN: ASYNC_REPLICATION_FALLBACK_MODE_UNKNOWN represents an unknown or uninitialized mode
 - ASYNC_REPLICATION_FALLBACK_MODE_ALLOW: ASYNC_REPLICATION_FALLBACK_MODE_ALLOW permits falling back to async replication
when no standby servers are available. This is the default behavior.
 - ASYNC_REPLICATION_FALLBACK_MODE_REJECT: ASYNC_REPLICATION_FALLBACK_MODE_REJECT rejects the leader appointment
if synchronous replication cannot be established to meet quorum requirements
clustermetadataAsyncReplicationFallbackM.title:
AsyncReplicationFallbackMode defines the behavior when insufficient standbys are available
for synchronous replication to meet the quorum requirement

policyVersion.title: policy_version allows policy evolution over time

quorumRule.title: quorum_rule defines the actual quorum requirements

isActive.title: is_active indicates if this is the current active policy

clustermetadataDurabilityPolicy.description:
DurabilityPolicy defines consensus quorum rules for a shard.
These policies are stored locally in each shard's postgres database
and replicated via postgres streaming replication.

component.title: component identifies the type of Multigres component (multipooler, multigateway, or multiorch)

cell.title: cell is the Multigres cell where the component is located

name.description:
name is a unique identifier for the component within the multigres
cluster.

clustermetadataID.description: ID is a globally unique pooler identifier.

start.title: start is the start key of the range (inclusive)

end.title: end is the end key of the range (exclusive)

clustermetadataKeyRange.title: KeyRange represents a range of keys for sharding

id.description: id is the unique identifier of the multipooler in the cluster.

shard.description:
Shard name. If range based sharding is used, it should match
key_range.

keyRange.description: If range based sharding is used, range for the pooler's shard.

type.title: PoolerType is the kind of pooler: PRIMARY or REPLICA

servingStatus.description: PoolerServingStatus is the current type of the pooler.

hostname.description: Fully qualified domain name of the host.

portMap.title: Map of named ports. These are ports that the pooler exposes. Initially, this will only be gRPC

clustermetadataMultiPooler.description: MultiPooler represents metadata about a running multipooler component instance in the cluster.

clustermetadataPoolerServingStatus.description:
PoolerServingStatus represents the serving status of the given MultiPooler.

 - SERVING: SERVING is the status a server during normal operations when it is serving traffic.
 - NOT_SERVING: NOT_SERVING is the status of a server when it is not serving traffic.
This typically occurs during startup, shutdown, or when the server is
in an error state and cannot accept connections.
 - BACKUP: BACKUP is the status of a server when it is taking a backup. No queries
can be served in BACKUP mode.
 - RESTORE: RESTORE is the status a server uses when restoring a backup, at
startup time.  No queries can be served in RESTORE mode.
 - DRAINED: DRAINED is the status a server goes into when used by Multigres tools
to perform an offline action. It is a serving type (as
the tools processes may need to run queries), but it's not used
to route queries from Multigres users. In this state,
this multipooler is dedicated to the process that uses it.
 - SERVING_RDONLY: SERVING_RDONLY is the status of a server in read-only mode.
This is used during demotion when the server transitions from PRIMARY to REPLICA,
or for read-only replicas. The server accepts connections but only serves read queries.

clustermetadataPoolerType.description:
PoolerType represents the type of a given MultiPooler.

 - UNKNOWN: UNKNOWN this is not a valid type.
It is useful during upgrades to detect when a value is not initialized
 - PRIMARY: PRIMARY is the primary server for the shard. Only PRIMARY allows DMLs.
 - REPLICA: REPLICA replicates from leader. It is used to read only traffic

quorumType.title: quorum_type determines which quorum algorithm to use

requiredCount.title:
required_count: number of nodes/cells required
- For QUORUM_TYPE_ANY_N: number of nodes required from discovered cohort
- For QUORUM_TYPE_MULTI_CELL_ANY_N: number of distinct cells required,
  with at least one node from each cell

asyncFallback.description:
async_fallback defines behavior when insufficient standbys are available
for synchronous replication. Defaults to ALLOW if unset.

clustermetadataQuorumRule.title: QuorumRule defines how many nodes are required for quorum

clustermetadataQuorumType.description:
- QUORUM_TYPE_UNKNOWN: QUORUM_TYPE_UNKNOWN represents an unknown or uninitialized quorum type
 - QUORUM_TYPE_ANY_N: QUORUM_TYPE_ANY_N requires any N nodes from discovered cohort
 - QUORUM_TYPE_MULTI_CELL_ANY_N: QUORUM_TYPE_MULTI_CELL_ANY_N requires nodes from multiple cells (availability zones)
with at least one node from each of the required cells
clustermetadataQuorumType.title: QuorumType enumerates supported quorum algorithms

finalLsn.title: Final checkpoint LSN (stop LSN) for this backup

jobId.title: Job ID annotation if present (for cross-process tracking)

backupSizeBytes.title: Size of the backup in bytes (original database size before compression)

type.title: Type of backup: "full", "diff", or "incr" (as reported by pgbackrest)

multipoolerId.title: Multipooler ID that created this backup (from pgbackrest annotation)

poolerType.title: Pooler type that created this backup (from pgbackrest annotation)

multipoolermanagerdataBackupMetadata.title: BackupMetadata contains metadata about a backup

multipoolermanagerdataBackupMetadataStat.title: Status represents the state of a backup

backupId.description:
backup_id uniquely identifies a backup and can be used to restore this
backup in the future.

multipoolermanagerdataBackupResponse.title: BackupResponse contains the result of a backup operation

numSync.title: Number of standby servers to wait for (quorum count)

standbyIds.title:
List of standby multipooler IDs that can participate in synchronous replication
The application names will be generated as {cell}_{name} from these IDs

multipoolermanagerdataConfigureSynchrono.title: ConfigureSynchronousReplication configures PostgreSQL synchronous replication settings

termNumber.title: Term number for this consensus term

acceptedTermFromCoordinatorId.title: ID of the coordinator (multiorch) that this node accepted the term from

leaderId.title: ID of the leader of the current term

multipoolermanagerdataConsensusTerm.title:
ConsensusTerm represents the consensus term information for the pooler
This is persisted to disk at $PGDATA/consensus/consensus_term.json

multipoolermanagerdataCreateDurabilityPo.title:
CreateDurabilityPolicyResponse confirms policy creation
Errors are returned via gRPC status codes, not in the response body

wasAlreadyDemoted.title: Whether the pooler was already demoted (idempotent check)

consensusTerm.title: Consensus term at the time of demotion

lsnPosition.title: LSN position at the time of demotion (final position as primary)

connectionsTerminated.title: Number of connections that were terminated

followerId.title: Cluster ID of the follower from synchronous_standby_names configuration

isConnected.title: Whether this follower is currently connected to the primary

replicationStats.title: Replication statistics (only populated if is_connected is true)

multipoolermanagerdataFollowerInfo.description:
Information about a follower that is part of the current cohort (configured in
synchronous_standby_names). Includes connection status and replication stats if connected.

backup.description: The backup metadata if found, nil if not found.

multipoolermanagerdataGetBackupByJobIdRe.description:
GetBackupByJobIdResponse returns the backup matching the job_id.
If no backup is found, backup will be nil.

multipoolermanagerdataGetBackupsResponse.title: GetBackupsResponse contains the list of backups

policy.title: The active durability policy, or null if none is configured

multipoolermanagerdataGetDurabilityPolic.title: GetDurabilityPolicyResponse returns the active durability policy

followers.description:
Information about all followers configured in synchronous_standby_names.
Each entry indicates whether the follower is connected and includes replication
statistics if available. This provides a complete view of the expected cohort.

syncConfig.title: Current synchronous replication configuration for context

finalLsn.title: Final LSN position after backup completed

backupId.title:
Backup ID of the initial backup created during initialization
This can be used by standbys to restore from the same backup

multipoolermanagerdataPrimaryConnInfo.title: Primary connection information parsed from PostgreSQL's primary_conninfo setting

lsn.title: Current WAL LSN position (PostgreSQL format: X/XXXXXXXX)

connectedFollowers.description:
Follower servers that are currently connected to the primary (parsed from pg_stat_replication).
This only includes followers that have an active replication connection, not all configured standbys.
For a complete view of all configured standbys (connected and disconnected), use GetFollowers.

syncReplicationConfig.title: Synchronous replication configuration (parsed from synchronous_standby_names and synchronous_commit)

wasAlreadyPrimary.title: Whether the pooler was already promoted (idempotent check)

consensusTerm.title: Consensus term at the time of promotion

multipoolermanagerdataReplicationPauseMo.description:
- REPLICATION_PAUSE_MODE_REPLAY_ONLY: PAUSE_REPLAY_ONLY pauses WAL replay only (using pg_wal_replay_pause)
The WAL receiver continues to receive data from the primary
 - REPLICATION_PAUSE_MODE_RECEIVER_ONLY: PAUSE_RECEIVER_ONLY stops the WAL receiver by clearing primary_conninfo
Already replayed WAL remains, but no new WAL is received
 - REPLICATION_PAUSE_MODE_REPLAY_AND_RECEIVER: PAUSE_REPLAY_AND_RECEIVER pauses both WAL replay and stops the WAL receiver
This is the most complete pause - no new WAL is received and nothing is replayed
multipoolermanagerdataReplicationPauseMo.title: Replication pause mode - defines what aspect of replication to pause

pid.title: PostgreSQL backend process ID for this replication connection

clientAddr.title: Client IP address of the follower

state.title: Current WAL sender state (startup, catchup, streaming, backup, stopping)

sentLsn.title: LSN of the last WAL location sent to this standby

writeLsn.title: LSN of the last WAL location written to disk on this standby

flushLsn.title: LSN of the last WAL location flushed to disk on this standby

replayLsn.title: LSN of the last WAL location replayed on this standby

writeLag.title: Time taken to write recent WAL locally (may be null)

flushLag.title: Time taken to flush recent WAL locally (may be null)

replayLag.title: Time taken to replay recent WAL on standby (may be null)

multipoolermanagerdataReplicationStats.title: Replication statistics for a connected follower from pg_stat_replication

status.title: Replication status when replication was reset

multipoolermanagerdataRestoreFromBackupR.title: RestoreFromBackupResponse contains the result of a restore operation

lastReplayLsn.title:
Last WAL position replayed during recovery (PostgreSQL format: X/XXXXXXXX)
Obtained from pg_last_wal_replay_lsn()

lastReceiveLsn.title:
Last WAL position received and synced to disk by standby (PostgreSQL format: X/XXXXXXXX)
Obtained from pg_last_wal_receive_lsn()

lag.title: Replication lag (optional, may not always be available)

primaryConnInfo.title: Primary connection info parsed from primary_conninfo setting

multipoolermanagerdataStandbyUpdateOpera.title: Enum representing the type of standby list modification

errorMessage.title: Error message if state is error

poolerType.title: Pooler type from topology (PRIMARY or REPLICA)

primaryStatus.title: Primary status information (only populated if pooler is acting as primary AND db is connected)

replicationStatus.title: Replication status information (only populated if pooler is acting as standby AND db is connected)

isInitialized.title: Whether this pooler has been initialized (has data directory and multigres schema)

postgresRole.description:
Current postgres-level role from pg_is_in_recovery ("primary", "standby", or "unknown")
This may differ from pooler_type during transitions or failures.

walPosition.title: Current WAL position (empty if db not connected)

shardId.title: Shard ID that this pooler belongs to

multipoolermanagerdataStatus.description:
Status provides unified status information that works for both PRIMARY and REPLICA poolers.
This RPC works even when the database connection is unavailable - fields that require
database access will be nil/empty in that case.

status.title: Replication status when replication was stopped (only populated if wait=true)

multipoolermanagerdataSynchronousCommitL.description:
- SYNCHRONOUS_COMMIT_OFF: OFF disables synchronous commit
 - SYNCHRONOUS_COMMIT_LOCAL: LOCAL waits for local flush to disk
 - SYNCHRONOUS_COMMIT_REMOTE_WRITE: REMOTE_WRITE waits for standby to receive and write WAL
 - SYNCHRONOUS_COMMIT_ON: ON waits for standby to receive, write, and flush WAL (same as remote_apply in newer versions)
 - SYNCHRONOUS_COMMIT_REMOTE_APPLY: REMOTE_APPLY waits for standby to receive, write, flush, and apply WAL
multipoolermanagerdataSynchronousCommitL.title: Synchronous commit level

multipoolermanagerdataSynchronousMethod.description:
- SYNCHRONOUS_METHOD_UNSPECIFIED: UNSPECIFIED means no synchronous replication (empty synchronous_standby_names)
 - SYNCHRONOUS_METHOD_FIRST: FIRST means wait for the first N standby servers (PostgreSQL default)
 - SYNCHRONOUS_METHOD_ANY: ANY means wait for any N standby servers
multipoolermanagerdataSynchronousMethod.title: Synchronization method for standby servers

standbyIds.title: List of standby IDs that can participate in synchronous replication
